title: Turtle Keyboard integration
description: Schema every integrations/<id>.yaml is validated against by CI.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier. Must match the YAML filename and the integration's KeyboardIntegration.id() return value.

owner.description: GitHub handle or team responsible for this integration.

surfaces.description: Which keyboard surfaces this integration uses. Drives the parity matrix layout and helps reviewers spot capability creep.

activates_on.description: When KeyboardIntegration.activate(...) returns non-null. Documentation only — not enforced by CI but used for conflict / overlap review.

host_packages.description: Android package names the integration matches against EditorInfo.packageName.

ios_host_apps.description: iOS bundle IDs the integration considers (note: iOS doesn't expose host bundle IDs to keyboard extensions; entries here document intent only).

commands.description: Slash command names this integration contributes (e.g. ["split", "splits"]). If a name has a backing commands/<name>.yaml the parity script links them; locally-handled commands without a backing YAML are allowed and listed for visibility only.

deep_screens.description: Screen ids opened via IntegrationContext.openScreen(id). The host app's IntegrationContext impl is responsible for routing each id to an Activity / view controller.
